Steel widget, 40 millimetre

A 40 millimetre steel widget, machined in one piece, sold singly or by the box.

£19.99 Add to basket

Diameter40 mm
Bore12 mm
Mass212 g
Materialhardened steel
Finishphosphate
Torque9 Nm
Stockin stock

What it is

The 40 millimetre steel widget is machined from one billet, so there is no seam to work loose and nothing to come apart in service.

It weighs 212 grams. The bore is 12 millimetre and holds tolerance to two hundredths, which is close enough for a press fit without a reamer.

What it is made of

Bar stock, hardened and tempered, then shot peened. The finish is a phosphate that takes oil and keeps it, which is what stops the surface rust you get on a plain part left in a damp shed.

We do not plate these. Plating fills the knurl and the knurl is the point.

Fitting it

Press it in cold. Heating the housing to fit a widget is a habit from larger sizes and it does nothing here except relieve the temper.

Support the far face while you press. A widget that goes in square stays in; one that goes in cocked will fret against the bore and come loose in a few hundred hours.

Torque the retaining screw to nine newton metres. Past twelve the thread in the housing strips before the screw does, which is a repair rather than a replacement.

How they are sold

Singly, or in a box of twenty five. The box works out cheaper per widget and comes with the fitting sleeve, which is otherwise a separate order.

Trade accounts get a further discount at five boxes. Ring the number at the foot of the page rather than ordering through the site, because the site cannot see your account terms.

Returns

Unfitted widgets go back within sixty days for a full refund. Fitted ones do not, because a pressed part cannot be sold again and we would rather say so than pretend otherwise.

A widget that fails in service inside two years is replaced, fitted or not. Send us the part and the machine hours and we will tell you what went wrong with it.
